title: Addit - AI Call Recording Landing Page
description: Modern marketing website for Addit, an AI-powered application for call recording and transcription, built with React and TypeScript.
longDescription: A sleek, responsive marketing website for Addit - an AI-powered call recording and transcription application. Built with React 18 and TypeScript, featuring a modern landing page, features showcase, and legal documentation pages. The site uses hash-based routing for GitHub Pages compatibility and is styled with Tailwind CSS for a polished, professional appearance.
